title: South Indian Filter Coffee

ingredients.as_written: South Indian Coffee 1.5 tbsp (Select a coffee brand with 80-20 or 60-40 Coffee Chicory ratio) - Brands: Malgudi
1/2 tbsp sugar - Can adjust based on preference (I am using zero calorie sweetner)
3/4 cup boiling hot milk (for best taste use full fat milk)

steps: In your filter, add coffee, cinnamon and sugar. Then gently dab the pressing disc on the coffee mixture (Don’t need to press it hard).
Add boiling water on top of the disc and cover the filter with the lid. Let it brew for 30 mins atleast.
Once all the liquid collects in the bottom container, add it in a glass. Then add hot milk in the the glass from a height to create foam at the top.
Transfer your coffee from one glass to another 2-3 times before pouring it in your cup.
assumptions: Makes 1 cup. You need a South Indian coffee filter (the creator bought one on Swiggy Instamart for Rs 280).
The ingredient list also names zero-calorie sweetener as an alternative or note; it isn’t listed separately.
